name: Calendar
description: A month grid, the coming weeks or an agenda of the next days, from the device's calendar provider (the Calendar Sources: iCal links, CalDAV servers, connected accounts and holidays). One page per view.

properties.name: weekStart
properties.title: Week Starts
properties.description: The first day of each week in the month grid.

properties.name: weekNumbers
properties.title: Week Numbers
properties.description: A column of week numbers (ISO 8601) at the left of the month grid.

properties.name: views
properties.title: Views
properties.description: One page per view, in this order: the month, the coming weeks as continuous rows, the agenda. Two or three views make a slot of that many pages.

properties.name: calendars
properties.title: Calendars
properties.description: Which calendars to show. None chosen: all that are enabled. Add calendars in the Calendar Sources settings.

properties.name: holidaySets
properties.title: Holidays
properties.description: Which holiday sets to show. None chosen: all that are enabled.

properties.name: weeksAhead
properties.title: Weeks Ahead
properties.description: How many weeks the weekly view shows after the current one.

properties.name: agendaDays
properties.title: Agenda Days
properties.description: How many days the agenda shows, today included.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.title: Text Size
properties.description: The size of the text on the pages.

properties.name: title
properties.title: Title
properties.description: The heading. Empty: the month's name, or Agenda.
